solves.reason: (A) persists (사라지는 게 아니라 오늘날까지 지속), (B) miscalculation (단순 오계산), (C) forgotten (수정이 곧 잊혀짐)
(A) accurately (그는 정확히 측정했으나 건조 시금치를 분석), (B) dried (건조 시금치 분석), (C) taken (myth had taken hold)
(A) content (high iron content — 함량), (B) superhuman (초인적 힘), (C) persuade (설득하다)
remembered(기억된)는 'swiftly forgotten'과 반대. 수정이 곧 잊혀졌다는 원문과 불일치 → remembered 부적절
stale(신선하지 않은)은 fresh와 반대. 본문은 fresh leafy greens → stale 부적절
less(더 적게)는 'dried spinach held ten times more iron'과 반대 → less 부적절
원문 'This is a legend that dates back to 1890' → legend
originating from miscalculation by physiologist → physiologist
dried spinach which held ten times more iron → held
persists = continues (지속된다)
accurately = precisely (정확하게)
swiftly = quickly (빠르게)
fresh의 반의어 = dried (건조된)
superhuman의 반의어 = ordinary (보통의)
(A) take hold = 자리잡다, (B) hold = 들다/잡다. 가장 자연스러운 의미 대응
널리 퍼진 거짓 믿음 = myth
(miscalculate) → 명사형 miscalculation
(persist) → 명사형 persistence
Popeye contributed to its persistence → persistence(지속)가 빈칸 답
parents persuade their children into eating the healthy vegetable → healthy
